Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.histogram

Class HistogramExtractor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.histogram.HistogramExtractor
@Component public class HistogramExtractor extends Object
Calculates and manages histograms for image regions in HSV color space. This class provides functionality to compute histograms for different regions of an image (corners and center) and combine them for analysis.

The class supports configurable histogram bins for Hue, Saturation, and Value channels, allowing for flexible histogram resolution based on analysis needs.

Key features:

  • Computes HSV histograms for image regions
  • Supports multiple image processing with combined histograms
  • Configurable bin sizes for each HSV channel
  • Normalizes histograms for consistent comparison

  • Method Details

    • setBins

      public void setBins(int hueBins, int satBins, int valBins)
      Sets the number of bins for each HSV channel in the histogram. This method modifies the histogram resolution and affects all subsequent histogram calculations.
      Parameters:
      hueBins - number of bins for the Hue channel (typically 30-180)
      satBins - number of bins for the Saturation channel (typically 1-256)
      valBins - number of bins for the Value channel (typically 1-256)

    • getHistogramFromRegion

      public HistogramRegions getHistogramFromRegion(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat maskOnScene)
      Computes histograms for a single masked region of an image. The mask defines the area of interest for histogram calculation.
      Parameters:
      maskOnScene - binary mask indicating the region to analyze
      Returns:
      HistogramRegions containing histograms for the masked region

    • getHistogramsHSV

      public HistogramRegions getHistogramsHSV(StateImage image)
      Computes HSV histograms for all regions of a StateImage. This method processes the image in HSV color space and calculates histograms for five regions: four corners and a central ellipse.
      Parameters:
      image - the StateImage to analyze
      Returns:
      HistogramRegions containing histograms for all regions
      See Also:
      • ColorCluster.ColorSchemaName.HSV

    • getHistogramRegions

      public void getHistogramRegions(HistogramRegions histRegs, org.bytedeco.javacpp.IntPointer channelsUsed, org.bytedeco.javacpp.IntPointer bins, org.bytedeco.javacpp.PointerPointer<org.bytedeco.javacpp.FloatPointer> ranges)
      Calculates histograms for all regions across multiple images. This method processes each image in the collection and accumulates histograms for each region. After processing all images, it combines the individual histograms.
      Parameters:
      histRegs - the HistogramRegions object to populate with histograms
      channelsUsed - pointer to array of channel indices to use
      bins - pointer to array of bin counts for each channel
      ranges - pointer to array of value ranges for each channel
